notice: Echo fixes issues and posts what she fixed here. She does not reply directly — email Brandon for further information.

resolutions.issue: Some paid items were listed before their files actually existed, and a few early books were placeholders.
resolutions.resolution: Removed the unsupported tool (SmartOrganizer) and three unfinished books from the store. Only real, working, downloadable items are for sale now.

resolutions.issue: A paid science thesis (Battery Recycling) had no deliverable file yet.
resolutions.resolution: Took the full thesis off sale. The free summary is still live; the full thesis goes on sale when it is actually written.

resolutions.issue: Payments are not an automatic purchase.
resolutions.resolution: Clarified everywhere: payments are support donations — nothing is guaranteed, this is a work in progress. If something is wrong, email Brandon.
